in_sanskrit.name: Gopee
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Worshipper of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gopee एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'.

in_hindi.name: Gopee
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Worshipper of God
in_hindi.long_meaning: Gopee एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'.

in_tamil.name: Gopee
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Worshipper of God
in_tamil.long_meaning: Gopee ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'.

in_telugu.name: Gopee
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Worshipper of God
in_telugu.long_meaning: Gopee ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'.

in_marathi.name: Gopee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worshipper of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'.

in_bengali.name: Gopee
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Worshipper of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gopee একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'.
